# Creating a modern website for a mountain cottage (2025-12-10 17:48Z)

_**User (2025-12-10 17:57Z)**_

Now I want to create very simple website for my mountain cottage, there is a content ready here: https://www.jindrichuvdum.cz/index.html, it is in czech and let's keep it in that language. I have also added pictures to #file:img directory. There is #file:gallery for pictures used in photo gallery showing how cottage looks like and then #file:background for pictures for background you can use. Please check it all out and try to create website for my mountain cottage in the same style as current index.html. Use same fonts and same color style. Ask any additional questions you may need. Important note: before doing anything copy current index.njk to practical-info.njk file and keep it in content.json as well. I do not want to replace this file. I need to create new presentation website for the cottage. Try to use some modern elements, but do not overdo it with icons and such. Clean and modern design is the goal.
